description: Review 3, acceptance 5 (a false silence on main): a local `const ctx = { skip() { return 1 } }`, once shadowing the test's ctx parameter and once without one. A `ctx.skip()` whose receiver is not the test callback's context parameter is not certainly the runner's: TG003 warns that it may skip the tests, never FAIL, never silence; the two warnings have the same cause in one file, so they are one that names both tests (noise round, grouping). `expect(ctx.task.name).toBe(…)` reads `ctx` only as an argument of `expect`, behind the opaque frontier of a call: not a use (round 7d).
